messages: Maya: Heads-up — finalizing the March Product Digest + webinar invite. Need to lock segmentation and send windows by EOD today. Draft + segments here: https://docs.google.com/product-digest-march (edit access for marketing) Jon: On it. Two main segments: 'Active devs' (engagers last 30d) and 'Trials - last 30d'. Confirming APAC send window 09:00 SGT? Priya: I recommend regionally staggered sends: NA 09:00 PT, EU 09:00 BST, APAC 09:00 SGT. Keeps open/click rates healthier. Sam: Subject line options are in the doc — my vote = A1: "Scale inference costs without compromising latency — Redwood's playbook". A2 (short): "Cut inference costs, keep speed" Nora: For the trial cohort please include a trial-extension CTA (14 days). Also add suppression for Dedicated/private account contacts. Maya: Good. Action items: Sam — update doc with subject variants + character counts; Priya — tweak APAC copy for regional phrasing; Jon — implement HubSpot segments + smart send. I'll own final QA & proof. Jon: HubSpot note: we'll create workflow id "newsletter_march_2026". Tag recipients with properties: trial_30d, active_dev. Need the final HTML from design and the export of the segment CSV. Lucy: Uploading responsive HTML to the doc now — paste of preheader and snippet below: ``` Quick wins: balance cost and latency — RSVP for webinar ``` Lucy: Also pushed a mobile-first CTA variant (larger tap target) — comments welcomed. Priya: Add webinar RSVP link and separate drip for registrants (reminders at 48h and 1h). Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (tracking UTM appended in doc) Sam: I'll A/B test the two subject lines and set up a 50/50 split for Active Devs. Can we cap NA send rate to 10k/hour to avoid throttles with our ESP? Maya: Yes — Jon pls coordinate send-rate with ops/infra. Also we need a short benchmark blurb for the top of the newsletter (1-2 bullets) that references the new numbers. Jon: Rahul on bench team has the latest. @Rahul can you paste a 1-2 sentence stat we can feature? Rahul: Quick stats we can use: "Caching + continuous batching reduced avg token cost by ~28% for standard chat workloads; p95 latency improved ~12% under representative traffic." I'll DM the raw tables and a one-line CTA-ready blurb. Maya: Perfect — insert Rahul's one-liner in the hero. Final checklist: 1) subjects in doc (Sam) 2) HTML in doc (Lucy) 3) HubSpot workflow + segments (Jon) 4) APAC copy + send windows (Priya) 5) benchmark blurb (Rahul) 6) suppression list for Dedicated/private (Nora). If no major blockers we target sends starting 2026-03-15 09:00 PT. Update this thread when HubSpot workflow is live. Priya: Noted — I'll post the APAC schedule when synced with timezone table. :wave: Jon: Will post HubSpot workflow link when created. Expect it before EOD. :thumbsup: Sam: I'll upload subject test results snapshot after the test runs (24h). Maya: Thanks everyone — ping here if anything slips. :pray:
